Tom / Susan — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Key takeaways:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency on patient-facing workflows while controlling cost (target: <100ms p95 for 512 tokens).
- Compliance/supply chain: need clarity on audit trails (retention, SOC 2 evidence) and data residency for PHI-adjacent metadata.
- Scale: current batch sizes and traffic patterns mean predictable throughput is a priority; dedicated capacity was discussed.

Next steps I propose to keep momentum: 
1) 30-min exec alignment (VP/CTO level) to align on success criteria and procurement path — this will unblock a technical deep dive and procurement timelines.
2) Technical deep dive/demo with your engineering lead to validate performance and integration approach (follow-up).

Suggested windows next week (PT):
- Wed 2029-04-03: 09:00–09:45 or 09:30–10:00
- Thu 2029-04-04: 13:00–13:45 or 14:00–14:30

I've attached a mutual action plan and a short SOC2 summary to help your procurement team. If any of the times above work, I can send a calendar invite (we'll include our CTO/Eng lead + Rishi).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.


Marissa Cole
